title: Certified incumbent retention and price-aware computation stopping
authority: Resolve final C24 branch HEAD and STAGE_RECEIPTS.jsonl at the next invocation; do not substitute the old original developer worktree.

execution_protocol.theory: R01-R10 actual construction, derivation, finite/CAS verification and claim decision
execution_protocol.coding: After theory, C01-C10 actual implementation, scientific checks, held-out measurement and one independent review
execution_protocol.every_stage: Backup cumulative checkpoint, commit/publish, verify remote identity; preserve failed outputs

starting_relations: For incumbent i, simple regret <= G_i = max(0,max_{j!=i} U_j - L_i) under valid intervals.
Switch only when L_j > U_i to obtain a true-utility-increasing incumbent update; assess lost opportunities.
If every proposed positive computation has verified cost C_tau >= c_min, its net improvement <= G_i - lambda*c_min.
Observed median/predicted wall time is not automatically a mathematical cost lower bound.
theory_questions: Define the controlled regret and incumbent contract; prove conditional guarantees without assuming monotone finite-budget action utility.
Distinguish exact charged work-count costs from stochastic wall-clock prediction; identify which economic stopping statement is proved and which is empirical.
Choose one constructive decision rule and preserve efficient PLAIN_STOP, PLAIN_ALWAYS and C24 FAST_BLOCK controls.
prospective_acceptance: No false optimum/relative-residual certificate; admitted arithmetic domain unchanged unless separately derived and verified.
Contractually defined incumbent utility nondecrease checked against exact oracles; C24 adverse fixture retained as regression only.
Primary wall-time economic comparison uses the declared price and normalization fixed before fresh TEST outcomes.
Count evaluator/controller costs and genuinely skipped operations; report negative results and useful rejected alternatives.
data_policy: Preserve C24 TEST as historical/regression evidence. New primary evidence requires fresh disjoint parent IDs/seeds and pre-execution source/code publication.
price_policy: Keep 1e-6 utility/us as the carried primary unless R01 prospectively justifies a different application unit before outcomes; retain the existing prespecified sensitivity range. Do not turn C24 descriptive break-even into a retrospectively favorable success threshold.
limits: No C25 implementation, benchmark, proof completion or publication result is claimed in this file.
